 Le Giang Patrik speaks out about the Vietnamese Golden Ball race.
 VHO - On the evening of November 18th, Vietnamese-born goalkeeper Le Giang Patrik shone brightly, winning the Man of the Match award and making a significant contribution to Ho Chi Minh City Police FC's 1-0 victory over defending champions Buriram United in the second match of Group A of the Shopee Cup 2026/27. Following the win, the goalkeeper shared some noteworthy thoughts about his aspirations to contribute to Vietnamese football and his chances of competing for the 2026 Vietnamese Golden Ball award.
 Báo Văn Hóa • 19/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Le Giang Patrik shone brightly in the 1-0 victory against Buriram United. Photo: Ho Chi Minh City Police Club. Facing a strong opponent from Thailand , Ho Chi Minh City Police FC was under immense pressure from the visitors' relentless attacks. In goal, Slovakian-Vietnamese goalkeeper Le Giang Patrik had an outstanding performance with a series of crucial saves to keep a clean sheet for the home team.
 The solid defense provided the foundation for Nguyen Thai Quoc Cuong to shine with a spectacular goal in the 88th minute, sealing a 1-0 victory. This also marked the first historic win for the Ho Chi Minh City Police Club in the Southeast Asian Club Championship.
 With 3 points earned against defending champions Buriram United, Ho Chi Minh City Police FC temporarily moved up to second place in Group A of the Shopee Cup 2026/27 with 4 points. The police team is currently tied on points with group leader Borneo FC but is temporarily ranked behind due to an inferior goal difference.
 With an impressive performance throughout the 90 minutes, Le Giang Patrik was voted Man of the Match. This brilliant form continues to garner significant attention from fans and experts as the race for the 2026 Vietnamese Golden Ball award enters its most exciting phase.
 You may also like When asked about his chances of competing for the most prestigious individual award in Vietnamese football , the goalkeeper born in 1992 frankly expressed his joy but affirmed that the success of the team is always the number one priority. He shared that he hasn't thought too much about the results yet, but only wants to focus entirely on his task on the field.
 “I don’t know what the Ballon d’Or results will be, but I will try my best to give my all when playing for the club. If I have the opportunity to win that title, I will be very happy. However, the most important thing is still the overall success of the team. I have been with Vietnam for four years and I yearn to continue making history,” Le Giang Patrik emphasized.
 Despite receiving individual awards after the match, the goalkeeper of Ho Chi Minh City Police FC still expressed great appreciation for the team's unity. He thanked the coaching staff and his teammates, and affirmed that whether playing for his club or the Vietnamese national team, he always takes to the field with the highest level of enthusiasm, and that today's achievement comes from the collective effort of the entire team.
 In addition, Le Giang Patrik also gave special praise to Nguyen Thai Quoc Cuong - who scored the only goal that brought 3 valuable points to the home team.
 “I’ve noticed Quoc Cuong’s development isn’t just in his skills on the field, but also through his persistent daily efforts, in how he’s matured into a true man. Today, Quoc Cuong played very well and proved himself to be an important player for the club. I’m very happy that the team is playing beautiful football and winning,” he shared.
 Le Giang Patrik's inclusion in the list of nominees for the 2026 Vietnam Golden Ball award is a well-deserved reward for a year of outstanding performances at both the national team and club levels.
 You may also like Previously, he had won the ASEAN Cup with the Vietnamese national team and was awarded the Best Goalkeeper title, while also making a significant contribution to the Ho Chi Minh City Police Club's victory in the National Cup.
 According to the organizers' plan, the official launch and introduction ceremony for the 2026 Vietnam Golden Ball Award is scheduled to take place on the morning of November 26th.
 With his consistent performance and outstanding contributions for both his club and the national team, Le Giang Patrik promises to be one of the strong contenders in this year's race.
